introduction_section.heading: What is an Enterprise-Grade
content: At Devisgon, we treat defensive security as an ongoing, adversarial discipline. Moving far beyond traditional, point-in-time annual penetration tests, we build resilient crowdsourced security frameworks that open your production apps, server networks, and code ecosystems to elite ethical hackers around the clock under strict, customized rules of engagement.

We bridge the gap between open-ended security research and internal engineering teams. Every program we manage features automated triage filtering, vulnerability verification, reward pricing strategies, and integration into your CI/CD pipelines, ensuring your web systems, databases, and microservices remain hardened against real-world exploits.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Continuous crowd-sourced defense, verified vulnerability metrics, 0% reliance on simple automated scanners.”

faq_section.title: Security Architecture & FAQ
faq_section.subtitle: Clear answers to critical crowd-sourced testing, researcher coordination, and perimeter safety queries

questions.question: What is the primary difference between a classic Penetration Test and a Bug Bounty program?
questions.answer: A Penetration Test typically relies on a single consultancy group auditing your code over a rigid 1-2 week window for a flat fee. A Bug Bounty program is continuous and crowd-sourced, opening your defined scopes to thousands of diverse security researchers around the globe who are compensated only when they discover actionable vulnerabilities.

questions.question: How do you protect our platform against rogue hackers trying to actively damage our database grids?
questions.answer: We enforce strict, granular Rules of Engagement. Every researcher must follow clear testing parameters—such as avoiding Denial of Service (DoS) attempts, using explicit test header tags, and accessing only custom mock data pools, which allows security teams to monitor and block invalid traffic footprints immediately.

questions.question: Can we run a highly secure, restricted program without exposing our code to the public web?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We build custom Private Bug Bounty programs. This model limits access exclusively to highly vetted, top-ranked ethical security researchers. The program operates under non-disclosure parameters within isolated staging runtimes, giving you deep defensive testing visibility before going public.

questions.question: How does your triage process prevent our engineering teams from getting swamped by duplicate reports?
questions.answer: We engineer a rigorous multi-stage validation proxy. Every incoming ticket runs through custom automation tooling and human code-replication audits. We independently verify, rate according to CVSS guidelines, and clean the files, routing only confirmed, net-new issues directly into your Jira or GitHub development backlogs.
